 Can 3 of 2023(Not in file)
 Pradip Kumar Saha & Anr.
 Vs.
 National Insurance Co. Ltd. & Ors.
 Mr. Abhishek Banerjee
 .....for the appellants
 Mr. Subrata Bhattacharya,,
 .... For the respondents.
In Re. Can 3 of 2023.
This is an application for appropriate order filed by the claimant/respondents.
The instant appeal is preferred by the owner of the vehicle.

Learned Tribunal has disposed of the application under Section 163A of Motor Vehicles Act directing the insurance Company to pay the compensation and by the same order the learned Tribunal has directed the Insurance Company to recover it from the owner of the vehicle.

It is the submission of the learned advocate for the claimants that the Insurance Company has already deposited cheque regarding the amount of compensation is the office of the learned Tribunal; as the instant appeal is pending, the learned Tribunal refrains from issue the cheque in favour of the claimants.
It is the submission of the learned advocate for the claimants that the instant appeal is pending since 2012.

He submitted the necessary direction may be passed, so that the Insurance Company be directed to produce a fresh cheque after returning the earlier one and it may be permitted to be withdrawn by the claimant.
Heard the learned advocates and perused the application; the owner of the vehicle i.e. appellant herein raise no objection.
Considering the same, the CAN 3 of 2023 is considered and allowed.

The respondent No.1 i.e.
Insurance Company is directed to issue a fresh cheque in the name of the claimants after withdrawing the cheque already deposited in the officer of the learned Tribunal.
The claimant is at liberty to withdraw the same re- deposited cheque.
On such receipt, the claimants are to report this court regarding such receipt.
